query: Which checkpoints are averaged for Transformer base and big models, and how does this differ from the way VGG combines multiple model predictions?

drafts: Transformer base模型平均最后5个checkpoint（以10分钟间隔写入），big模型平均最后20个checkpoint[1]。VGG则通过平均多个模型的soft-max类别后验概率来组合预测[2]，这与Transformer按时间顺序选取末尾checkpoint做权重的平均方式不同。

citations.quote: For the base models, we used a single model obtained by averaging the last 5 checkpoints, which were written at 10-minute intervals. For the big models, we averaged the last 20 checkpoints.

requirements.reason: 答案正确说明 VGG 通过平均多个模型的 soft-max 类别后验概率来组合预测，并明确对比了与 Transformer 平均末尾 checkpoint 的差异，引用[2]支撑。

citations.quote: In this part of the exper- iments, we combine the outputs of several models by averaging their soft-max class posteriors.

cited_sources.text: The Transformer (big) model trained for English-to-French used dropout rate Pdrop = 0.1, instead of 0.3. For the base models, we used a single model obtained by averaging the last 5 checkpoints, which were written at 10-minute intervals. For the big models, we averaged the last 20 checkpoints. We used beam search with a beam size of 4 and length penalty α = 0.6 [31]. These hyperparameters were chosen after experimentation on the development set.

In this part of the exper- iments, we combine the outputs of several models by averaging their soft-max class posteriors. This improves the performance due to complementarity of the models, and was used in the top ILSVRC submissions in 2012 (Krizhevsky et al., 2012) and 2013 (Zeiler & Fergus, 2013; Sermanet et al., 2014).
